title: Qlik Engine Memory and RAM Pressure
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.
app: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:engine metric=ram_committed_bytes
| bin _time span=5m
| stats max(value) as ram_bytes by host, _time
| eval ram_gb=round(ram_bytes/1024/1024/1024,1)
| where ram_gb>200
| sort - _time
description: Monitors Qlik Sense engine memory consumption, since Qlik holds apps in RAM and out-of-memory conditions crash sessions and reloads.
value: Qlik is memory-bound; watching RAM headroom prevents the out-of-memory failures that take down user sessions and reloads.
implementation: Ingest engine metrics; schedule every 5 minutes; tune the threshold to node RAM; alert before exhaustion. Rebalance apps across nodes.
visualization: Timechart of engine RAM per node, alert on high usage.
grandmaExplanation: We watch how much memory your Qlik servers use so they do not run out and crash people's sessions.
